value_as_written: Libreta de enrolamiento No. - "Consulado General Argentino, Cape Town". Dist. Militar: dash. Matricula: dash. *** Ano 1915. ***
note: *** READ 16 SEPTEMBER 2026 FROM DAVID'S OWN PHOTOGRAPHS, page 6 of the booklet - a page this archive had never transcribed. *** The enrolment book he produced as proof of nationality was issued at the CAPE TOWN CONSULATE, and it is dated *** 1915 ***, not 1908. The archive's ficha de enrolamiento is of 1908. So there are TWO Argentine enrolment events, or the 1908 card and the 1915 libreta are different instruments. *** A new document to chase in Buenos Aires. ***

value_as_written: Cedula de identidad No.: dash. Otorgada por: dash. Fecha: dash.
note: *** He held no Argentine identity card. ***

value_as_written: *** "Acta del Registro Civil (o fe de bautismo) extendida por ______" - THE LINE IS BLANK. ***
note: *** THIS IS THE FINDING ON THE PAGE. *** In December 1940, applying to his own consulate, Pablo Armando produced NO BIRTH CERTIFICATE AND NO BAPTISMAL CERTIFICATE. The consul accepted his nationality on the enrolment book alone. *** This archive has read the Rosario registers act by act looking for his baptism and found nothing. Here is contemporary evidence that HE DID NOT HAVE ONE EITHER. *** It does not prove no act exists. It does mean that the man himself, at fifty-eight, could not or did not produce one.

value_as_written: "Cumplio con la Ley Militar? Hizo su servicio militar en la Guardia Nacional 6o de Caballeria."
note: Already held; confirmed in his own hand on the booklet.

value_as_written: *** A photograph of Pablo Armando is affixed and consular-stamped. *** Head and shoulders, dark suit, white shirt, dark tie, hair swept back, aged about 58.
note: The only known likeness of him held by this archive.

value_as_written: *** "P. A. Lerena" *** in his own hand, under "firma del interesado"
note: He signed his Argentine names, not "Robert Paul", on an official document in 1940 - thirty-two years after the enrolment card and ten years before he died as Robert Paul.
